run_split_opt_in_out_urls_scan_job: run the SplitOptInOutUrlsScanJobRunner to scan image URLs in a dataset split for opt-in/opt-out status
compute_opt_in_out_urls_scan_response: compute the opt-in/opt-out URLs scan response for a specific dataset split using the spawning API
scan_urls_batched: scan a list of image URLs in batches using opt_in_out_scan_urls with rate limiting and concurrency controls
check_spawning_api: check image URLs against the spawning API to determine their opt-in/opt-out status
create_opt_url_objects: create OptUrl objects from scanned URL indices with row and column metadata for the response
